command: cd /workspace; sed -n 363,420p .loa.config.yaml; grep -n 'integrity_enforcement\|qmd_context' .loa.config.yaml; .claude/scripts/lib/profile-lib.sh knob guardrails.input.enabled false 2>&1 | tail -2; which br cheval; ls .claude/scripts/adversarial-review.sh .claude/scripts/verdict-derive.sh; git -C /workspace diff --stat HEAD | tail -1; echo ====; cd pr && git apply --stat head.diff 2>/dev/null | tail -75

cd /workspace; echo "== knobs"; .claude/scripts/lib/profile-lib.sh knob guardrails.input.enabled false 2>&1 | tail -1; .claude/scripts/lib/profile-lib.sh knob flatline_protocol.security_audit.enabled false 2>&1 | tail -1; .claude/scripts/lib/profile-lib.sh knob flatline_protocol.code_review.enabled false 2>&1 | tail -1; .claude/scripts/lib/profile-lib.sh knob invisible_retrospective.enabled false 2>&1 | tail -1; grep -n '^integrity_enforcement\|^  integrity_enforcement' .loa.config.yaml; echo "== tools"; jq --version; bats --version 2>&1 | head -1; which br cheval yq shellcheck bash; bash --version | head -1; echo "== LOA_RUN_MODE=$LOA_RUN_MODE LOA_GUARDRAILS_ENABLED=$LOA_GUARDRAILS_ENABLED"; echo "== known failures"; ls -la grimoires/loa/known-failures.md 2>&1; echo "== diff stat"; cd pr && git apply --stat head.diff 2>/dev/null | tail -75

set -u; AW=/home/evaluser/aw; mkdir -p "$AW"; [[ -d "$AW/head" ]] || cp -a /tmp/audit-work/head "$AW/head"; [[ -d "$AW/head-lbl" ]] || cp -a /tmp/audit-work/head-lbl "$AW/head-lbl"; if [[ ! -d "$AW/base-tree" ]]; then cp -a /tmp/audit-work/head "$AW/base-tree"; tgt=$(find "$AW/base-tree" -name block-destructive-bash.sh -path '*safety*'); cp /workspace/pr/base/.claude/hooks/safety/block-destructive-bash.sh "$tgt"; fi; find "$AW" -name '*.sh' -type f -exec chmod +x {} +; BASE=$(find "$AW/base-tree" -name block-destructive-bash.sh -path '*safety*'); HEAD=$(find "$AW/head" -name block-destructive-bash.sh -path '*safety*'); cmp -s "$BASE" /workspace/pr/base/.claude/hooks/safety/block-destructive-bash.sh && echo "base hook ok"; cmp -s "$HEAD" /workspace/pr/head/.claude/hooks/safety/block-destructive-bash.sh && echo "head hook ok"; echo "== replay"; while IFS= read -r row; do name=$(jq -r .name <<<"$row"); payload=$(jq -c --arg cwd "$AW/head" '{tool_name:"Bash",tool_input:{command:.cmd},cwd:$cwd}' <<<"$row"); (cd "$AW/base-tree"; printf '%s' "$payload" | CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="$AW/base-tree" LOA_REPO_ROOT="$AW/base-tree" bash "$BASE" >/dev/null 2>"$AW/b.err"); hb=$?; (cd "$AW/head"; printf '%s' "$payload" | CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="$AW/head" LOA_REPO_ROOT="$AW/head" bash "$HEAD" >/dev/null 2>"$AW/h.err"); he=$?; flag=""; [[ $hb == 2 && $he == 0 ]] && flag="  <-- REGRESSION"; rule=$(grep -o 'BLOCKED \[[^]]*\]' "$AW/h.err" | head -1); brule=$(grep -o 'BLOCKED \[[^]]*\]' "$AW/b.err" | head -1); printf '%-32s base=%s %-22s head=%s %-22s%s\n' "$name" "$hb" "$brule" "$he" "$rule" "$flag"; done < /tmp/audit-work/shapes.jsonl; echo "== last base stderr (if any):"; head -3 "$AW/b.err"
